properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 25 at 12:22PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 1222 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles west of San Acacio, or 16 miles southeast of San Luis Valley
Airport, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
San Acacio.
